description: Pins the repository-committed inputs that rebuild-content-core.mjs uses to rebuild the Quran content core. A changed input fails the rebuild. Changing this file needs owner approval and a source-verification review.

supabase/migrations/20260818042151_a1e93.role: Arabic text of the 58-ayah bootstrap (api.alquran.cloud quran-uthmani, 7 surahs); the Tanzil migration never overwrites these

supabase/migrations/20260820160000_e9c3f.role: Tanzil Uthmani 1.1 import: 107 surahs, 6,178 ayahs (generated from the Tanzil artifact whose checksum is in its header)

supabase/migrations/20260820180000_e471a.role: Pickthall translation, Project Gutenberg eBook #16955: 6,236 rows

scripts/quran-import/kazimirski/kazimirs.role: Kazimirski segments, text hashes and canonical ayah targets (phase4-manifest-v2, human-reviewed)

scripts/quran-import/kazimirski/texte_en.role: Frozen raw fr.wikisource.org page the manifest was extracted from

recorded_external_artifacts.note: Hashes recorded by the project for third-party files. They are NOT re-fetched or re-verified by the rebuild (it uses no network); they document provenance and are the pins a future re-fetch would check.
recorded_external_artifacts.sources: PHASE8C-CONTENT-SOURCE-GOVERNANCE.md section 3 and section 6; migration headers
